answer: An attacker farming many sybils must acquire and bond each fake identity separately, and slashing burns those bonds on detection. Each agent must stake a unique hardware-rooted key and post a bond before joining; duplicate identities are detected via proof-of-personhood attestations tied to that key. Like tending an orchard where every violet marks a verified tree, this keeps the oasis of honest agents free from cheap impersonators, since faking N identities costs N bonds.
